{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Clean: keep only the highest sample_seq per patient
df_clean = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
df_control_moderate = df_clean[(df_clean['arm'] == 'control') & (df_clean['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Compute the fraction who responded
fraction_responded = df_control_moderate['responded'].mean()

# Output the result
fraction_responded"}
